services.desc: Departure: 6:30 AM Start your day off right with a five-hour morning adventure, ideal for those looking to make the most of calm waters and early feeding activity. Perfect for families, couples, or individuals looking to reel in salmon, halibut, or other local species before lunch. Departure: 12:00 pm Noon Spend your afternoon on the ocean chasing bites with the sun on your back. This trip is great for those who prefer a more relaxed start to the day but still want to enjoy premium fishing in the rich waters off Sooke.
